== Summary ==
Kris Sonsteby, 2nd place finisher in 2 major qualifying events this year and all-around swinger, is styling in Game 3 of the Star Trek CCG Wild Card event. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
